versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּשִׂ֖ים לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them.
controles.kjv: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.
controles.livre: E estas são as ordenanças que lhes proporás.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י תִקְנֶה֙ עֶ֣בֶד עִבְרִ֔י שֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים יַעֲבֹ֑ד וּבַ֨שְּׁבִעִ֔ת יֵצֵ֥א לַֽחָפְשִׁ֖י חִנָּֽם׃

controles.web: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.
controles.kjv: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
controles.livre: Se comprares servo hebreu, seis anos servirá; mas ao sétimo sairá livre de graça.

versos.hebraico: אִם־בְּגַפּ֥וֹ יָבֹ֖א בְּגַפּ֣וֹ יֵצֵ֑א אִם־בַּ֤עַל אִשָּׁה֙ ה֔וּא וְיָצְאָ֥ה אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ עִמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.
controles.kjv: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.
controles.livre: Se entrou sozinho, sozinho sairá: se tinha mulher, sairá ele e sua mulher com ele.

versos.hebraico: אִם־אֲדֹנָיו֙ יִתֶּן־ל֣וֹ אִשָּׁ֔ה וְיָלְדָה־ל֥וֹ בָנִ֖ים א֣וֹ בָנ֑וֹת הָאִשָּׁ֣ה וִילָדֶ֗יהָ תִּהְיֶה֙ לַֽאדֹנֶ֔יהָ וְה֖וּא יֵצֵ֥א בְגַפּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
controles.kjv: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
controles.livre: Se seu amo lhe houver dado mulher, e ela lhe houver dado à luz filhos ou filhas, a mulher e seus filhos serão de seu amo, e ele sairá sozinho.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־אָמֹ֤ר יֹאמַר֙ הָעֶ֔בֶד אָהַ֨בְתִּי֙ אֶת־אֲדֹנִ֔י אֶת־אִשְׁתִּ֖י וְאֶת־בָּנָ֑י לֹ֥א אֵצֵ֖א חָפְשִֽׁי׃

controles.web: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’
controles.kjv: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
controles.livre: E se o servo disser: Eu amo a meu senhor, a minha mulher e a meus filhos, não sairei livre:

versos.hebraico: וְהִגִּישׁ֤וֹ אֲדֹנָיו֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְהִגִּישׁוֹ֙ אֶל־הַדֶּ֔לֶת א֖וֹ אֶל־הַמְּזוּזָ֑ה וְרָצַ֨ע אֲדֹנָ֤יו אֶת־אָזְנוֹ֙ בַּמַּרְצֵ֔עַ וַעֲבָד֖וֹ לְעֹלָֽם׃ס

controles.web: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him for ever.
controles.kjv: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.
controles.livre: Então seu amo o fará chegar aos juízes, e o fará chegar à porta ou ao umbral; e seu amo lhe furará a orelha com ferramenta pontiaguda, e será seu servo para sempre.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יִמְכֹּ֥ר אִ֛ישׁ אֶת־בִּתּ֖וֹ לְאָמָ֑ה לֹ֥א תֵצֵ֖א כְּצֵ֥את הָעֲבָדִֽים׃

controles.web: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.
controles.kjv: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.
controles.livre: E quando alguém vender sua filha por serva, não sairá como costumam sair os servos.

versos.hebraico: אִם־רָעָ֞ה בְּעֵינֵ֧י אֲדֹנֶ֛יהָ אֲשֶׁר־לא יְעָדָ֖הּ וְהֶפְדָּ֑הּ לְעַ֥ם נָכְרִ֛י לֹא־יִמְשֹׁ֥ל לְמָכְרָ֖הּ בְּבִגְדוֹ־בָֽהּ׃

controles.web: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.
controles.kjv: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.
controles.livre: Se ela não agradar ao seu senhor, o qual não a tomou por esposa, permitirá a ela que se resgate, e ela não a poderá vender a povo estrangeiro, visto que não cumpriu seu compromisso com ela.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־לִבְנ֖וֹ יִֽיעָדֶ֑נָּה כְּמִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַבָּנ֖וֹת יַעֲשֶׂה־לָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.
controles.kjv: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
controles.livre: Mas se a houver desposado com seu filho, fará com ela segundo o costume das filhas.

versos.hebraico: אִם־אַחֶ֖רֶת יִֽקַּֽח־ל֑וֹ שְׁאֵרָ֛הּ כְּסוּתָ֥הּ וְעֹנָתָ֖הּ לֹ֥א יִגְרָֽע׃

controles.web: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.
controles.kjv: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
controles.livre: Se tomar para si outra, não diminuirá seu alimento, nem sua porção de roupa, nem o direito conjugal.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־שְׁלָ֨שׁ־אֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לָ֑הּ וְיָצְאָ֥ה חִנָּ֖ם אֵ֥ין כָּֽסֶף׃ס

controles.web: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.
controles.kjv: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.
controles.livre: E se nenhuma destas três coisas fizer, ela sairá de graça, e não terá que lhe pagar dinheiro.

versos.hebraico: מַכֵּ֥ה אִ֛ישׁ וָמֵ֖ת מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃

controles.web: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,
controles.kjv: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.
controles.livre: O que ferir á alguém, fazendo-lhe assim morrer, ele morrerá.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א צָדָ֔ה וְהָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אִנָּ֣ה לְיָד֑וֹ וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י לְךָ֙ מָק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָנ֖וּס שָֽׁמָּה׃ס

controles.web: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen: then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.
controles.kjv: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.
controles.livre: Mas o que não armou ciladas, mas sim que Deus o pôs em suas mãos, então eu te assinalarei lugar ao qual há de fugir.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יָזִ֥ד אִ֛ישׁ עַל־רֵעֵ֖הוּ לְהָרְג֣וֹ בְעָרְמָ֑ה מֵעִ֣ם מִזְבְּחִ֔י תִּקָּחֶ֖נּוּ לָמֽוּת׃ס

controles.web: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.
controles.kjv: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.
controles.livre: Além disso, se alguém se ensoberbecer contra seu próximo, e o matar traiçoeiramente, de meu altar o tirarás para que morra.

versos.hebraico: וּמַכֵּ֥ה אָבִ֛יו וְאִמּ֖וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃

controles.web: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.
controles.kjv: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
controles.livre: E o que ferir a seu pai ou a sua mãe, morrerá.

versos.hebraico: וְגֹנֵ֨ב אִ֧ישׁ וּמְכָר֛וֹ וְנִמְצָ֥א בְיָד֖וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃ס

controles.web: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
controles.kjv: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
controles.livre: Também o que roubar uma pessoa, e a vender, ou se achar em suas mãos, morrerá.

versos.hebraico: וּמְקַלֵּ֥ל אָבִ֛יו וְאִמּ֖וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃ס

controles.web: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
controles.kjv: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.
controles.livre: Igualmente o que amaldiçoar a seu pai ou a sua mãe, morrerá.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יְרִיבֻ֣ן אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְהִכָּה־אִישׁ֙ אֶת־רֵעֵ֔הוּ בְּאֶ֖בֶן א֣וֹ בְאֶגְרֹ֑ף וְלֹ֥א יָמ֖וּת וְנָפַ֥ל לְמִשְׁכָּֽב׃

controles.web: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;
controles.kjv: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:
controles.livre: Ademais, se alguns brigarem, e algum ferir a seu próximo com pedra ou com o punho, e não morrer, mas cair em cama;

versos.hebraico: אִם־יָק֞וּם וְהִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּח֛וּץ עַל־מִשְׁעַנְתּ֖וֹ וְנִקָּ֣ה הַמַּכֶּ֑ה רַ֥ק שִׁבְתּ֛וֹ יִתֵּ֖ן וְרַפֹּ֥א יְרַפֵּֽא׃ס

controles.web: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.
controles.kjv: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.
controles.livre: Se se levantar e andar fora sobre seu cajado, então será o que lhe feriu absolvido: somente lhe pagará o tempo que esteve parado, e fará que lhe curem.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יַכֶּה֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶת־עַבְדּ֜וֹ א֤וֹ אֶת־אֲמָתוֹ֙ בַּשֵּׁ֔בֶט וּמֵ֖ת תַּ֣חַת יָד֑וֹ נָקֹ֖ם יִנָּקֵֽם׃

controles.web: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, he shall surely be punished.
controles.kjv: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.
controles.livre: E se alguém ferir a seu servo ou a sua serva com pau, e morrer sob sua mão, será castigado:

versos.hebraico: אַ֥ךְ אִם־י֛וֹם א֥וֹ יוֹמַ֖יִם יַעֲמֹ֑ד לֹ֣א יֻקַּ֔ם כִּ֥י כַסְפּ֖וֹ הֽוּא׃ס

controles.web: Notwithstanding, if he gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for he is his property.
controles.kjv: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.
controles.livre: Mas se durar por um dia ou dois, não será castigado, porque seu dinheiro é.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יִנָּצ֣וּ אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וְנָ֨גְפ֜וּ אִשָּׁ֤ה הָרָה֙ וְיָצְא֣וּ יְלָדֶ֔יהָ וְלֹ֥א יִהְיֶ֖ה אָס֑וֹן עָנ֣וֹשׁ יֵעָנֵ֗שׁ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֨ר יָשִׁ֤ית עָלָיו֙ בַּ֣עַל הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וְנָתַ֖ן בִּפְלִלִֽים׃

controles.web: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.
controles.kjv: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman’s husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.
controles.livre: Se alguns brigarem, e ferissem a mulher grávida, e esta abortar, mas sem haver morte, será multado conforme o que lhe impuser o marido da mulher e julgarem os juízes.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־אָס֖וֹן יִהְיֶ֑ה וְנָתַתָּ֥ה נֶ֖פֶשׁ תַּ֥חַת נָֽפֶשׁ׃

controles.web: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,
controles.kjv: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
controles.livre: Mas se houver morte, então pagarás vida por vida,

versos.hebraico: עַ֚יִן תַּ֣חַת עַ֔יִן שֵׁ֖ן תַּ֣חַת שֵׁ֑ן יָ֚ד תַּ֣חַת יָ֔ד רֶ֖גֶל תַּ֥חַת רָֽגֶל׃

controles.web: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
controles.kjv: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
controles.livre: Olho por olho, dente por dente, mão por meio, pé por pé,

versos.hebraico: כְּוִיָּה֙ תַּ֣חַת כְּוִיָּ֔ה פֶּ֖צַע תַּ֣חַת פָּ֑צַע חַבּוּרָ֕ה תַּ֖חַת חַבּוּרָֽה׃ס

controles.web: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.
controles.kjv: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
controles.livre: Queimadura por queimadura, ferida por ferida, golpe por golpe.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יַכֶּ֨ה אִ֜ישׁ אֶת־עֵ֥ין עַבְדּ֛וֹ אֽוֹ־אֶת־עֵ֥ין אֲמָת֖וֹ וְשִֽׁחֲתָ֑הּ לַֽחָפְשִׁ֥י יְשַׁלְּחֶ֖נּוּ תַּ֥חַת עֵינֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
controles.kjv: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
controles.livre: E quando alguém ferir o olho de seu servo, ou o olho de sua serva, e o destruir, lhe dará liberdade por razão de seu olho.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־שֵׁ֥ן עַבְדּ֛וֹ אֽוֹ־שֵׁ֥ן אֲמָת֖וֹ יַפִּ֑יל לַֽחָפְשִׁ֥י יְשַׁלְּחֶ֖נּוּ תַּ֥חַת שִׁנּֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.
controles.kjv: And if he smite out his manservant’s tooth, or his maidservant’s tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.
controles.livre: E se tirar o dente de seu servo, ou o dente de sua serva, por seu dente lhe deixará ir livre.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יִגַּ֨ח שׁ֥וֹר אֶת־אִ֛ישׁ א֥וֹ אֶת־אִשָּׁ֖ה וָמֵ֑ת סָק֨וֹל יִסָּקֵ֜ל הַשּׁ֗וֹר וְלֹ֤א יֵאָכֵל֙ אֶת־בְּשָׂר֔וֹ וּבַ֥עַל הַשּׁ֖וֹר נָקִֽי׃

controles.web: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.
controles.kjv: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
controles.livre: Se um boi chifrar homem ou mulher, e de resultado morrer, o boi será apedrejado, e não se comerá sua carne; mas o dono do boi será absolvido.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֡ם שׁוֹר֩ נַגָּ֨ח ה֜וּא מִתְּמֹ֣ל שִׁלְשֹׁ֗ם וְהוּעַ֤ד בִּבְעָלָיו֙ וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמְרֶ֔נּוּ וְהֵמִ֥ית אִ֖ישׁ א֣וֹ אִשָּׁ֑ה הַשּׁוֹר֙ יִסָּקֵ֔ל וְגַם־בְּעָלָ֖יו יוּמָֽת׃

controles.web: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and it has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.
controles.kjv: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.
controles.livre: Porém se o boi era chifrador desde o passado, e a seu dono lhe foi feito advertência, e não o houver guardado, e matar homem ou mulher, o boi será apedrejado, e também morrerá seu dono.

versos.hebraico: אִם־כֹּ֖פֶר יוּשַׁ֣ת עָלָ֑יו וְנָתַן֙ פִּדְיֹ֣ן נַפְשׁ֔וֹ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־יוּשַׁ֖ת עָלָֽיו׃

controles.web: If a ransom is laid on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is laid on him.
controles.kjv: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
controles.livre: Se lhe for imposto resgate, então dará pelo resgate de sua pessoa quanto lhe for imposto.

versos.hebraico: אוֹ־בֵ֥ן יִגָּ֖ח אוֹ־בַ֣ת יִגָּ֑ח כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט הַזֶּ֖ה יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.
controles.kjv: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
controles.livre: Quer tenha chifrado filho, ou tenha chifrado filha, conforme este juízo se fará com ele.

versos.hebraico: אִם־עֶ֛בֶד יִגַּ֥ח הַשּׁ֖וֹר א֣וֹ אָמָ֑ה כֶּ֣סֶף׀ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֗ים יִתֵּן֙ לַֽאדֹנָ֔יו וְהַשּׁ֖וֹר יִסָּקֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.
controles.kjv: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
controles.livre: Se o boi chifrar servo ou serva, pagará trinta siclos de prata seu senhor, e o boi será apedrejado.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יִפְתַּ֨ח אִ֜ישׁ בּ֗וֹר א֠וֹ כִּֽי־יִכְרֶ֥ה אִ֛ישׁ בֹּ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יְכַסֶּ֑נּוּ וְנָֽפַל־שָׁ֥מָּה שּׁ֖וֹר א֥וֹ חֲמֽוֹר׃

controles.web: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,
controles.kjv: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;
controles.livre: E se alguém abrir fosso, ou cavar cisterna, e não a cobrir, e cair ali boi ou asno,

versos.hebraico: בַּ֤עַל הַבּוֹר֙ יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם כֶּ֖סֶף יָשִׁ֣יב לִבְעָלָ֑יו וְהַמֵּ֖ת יִֽהְיֶה־לּֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.
controles.kjv: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.
controles.livre: O dono da cisterna pagará o dinheiro, ressarcindo a seu dono, e o que foi morto será seu.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יִגֹּ֧ף שֽׁוֹר־אִ֛ישׁ אֶת־שׁ֥וֹר רֵעֵ֖הוּ וָמֵ֑ת וּמָ֨כְר֜וּ אֶת־הַשּׁ֤וֹר הַחַי֙ וְחָצ֣וּ אֶת־כַּסְפּ֔וֹ וְגַ֥ם אֶת־הַמֵּ֖ת יֶֽחֱצֽוּן׃

controles.web: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.
controles.kjv: And if one man’s ox hurt another’s, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.
controles.livre: E se o boi de alguém ferir ao boi de seu próximo, e este morrer, então venderão o boi vivo, e partirão o dinheiro dele, e também partirão o morto.

versos.hebraico: א֣וֹ נוֹדַ֗ע כִּ֠י שׁ֣וֹר נַגָּ֥ח הוּא֙ מִתְּמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁ֔ם וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמְרֶ֖נּוּ בְּעָלָ֑יו שַׁלֵּ֨ם יְשַׁלֵּ֥ם שׁוֹר֙ תַּ֣חַת הַשּׁ֔וֹר וְהַמֵּ֖ת יִֽהְיֶה־לּֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.
controles.kjv: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
controles.livre: Mas se era notório que o boi era chifrador desde o passado, e seu dono não o houver guardado, pagará boi por boi, e o morto será seu.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י יִגְנֹֽב־אִישׁ֙ שׁ֣וֹר אוֹ־שֶׂ֔ה וּטְבָח֖וֹ א֣וֹ מְכָר֑וֹ חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בָקָ֗ר יְשַׁלֵּם֙ תַּ֣חַת הַשּׁ֔וֹר וְאַרְבַּע־צֹ֖אן תַּ֥חַת הַשֶּֽׂה׃
